CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dic_admin_push_claim_poll()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare won boolean;
begin
 update private.dic_admin_push_runtime set last_polled_at=now()
 where singleton=true
   and (last_polled_at is null or last_polled_at<=now()-interval '4 minutes')
 returning true into won;
 return coalesce(won,false);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dic_admin_push_runtime_keys()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare info jsonb;
begin
 select jsonb_build_object('publicKey',r.vapid_public,'privateKey',d.decrypted_secret)
 into info from private.dic_admin_push_runtime r
 join vault.decrypted_secrets d on d.id=r.vault_secret_id
 where r.singleton=true;
 return info;
end;
$function$

functions_complete_current_sources.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dic_admin_push_snapshot()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object(
  'admin_ids',coalesce((
   select jsonb_agg(a.owner_id order by a.owner_id)
   from private.app_admins a join private.beta_members m on m.owner_id=a.owner_id
   where m.admitted_at is not null and m.enabled
  ),'[]'::jsonb),
  'tokens',coalesce((
   select jsonb_agg(t.token order by t.token)
   from (
    select 'signup:'||m.owner_id::text as token
    from private.beta_members m
    join auth.users u on u.id=m.owner_id
    where m.admitted_at is null and m.signup_review_state='pending'
      and u.email_confirmed_at is not null
    union
    select 'coffee:'||s.id::text from public.coffee_submissions s
      where s.status in ('pending','conflict')
    union
    select 'delete:'||op.id::text from private.dic_admin_account_delete_operations op
      where op.phase<>'completed'
   ) t
  ),'[]'::jsonb)
 );
$function$
